competitor_shortcomings: No competitor offers a lightweight, completely free interactive browser-based HACCP plan builder with CCP determination for catering.
Most competitors either gate access behind $79/mo SaaS subscriptions (FoodDocs), annual trade fees (NCASS), or training courses (High Speed Training).
Government tools (MyHACCP) are designed for industrial manufacturers, overwhelming small independent takeaways.
None provide instant A4 landscape PDF layout formatting with customizable hazard controls and CSV export.
our_key_differentiators: 100% Free, zero-signup interactive HACCP builder covering all 7 Codex Alimentarius principles.
Pre-loaded with official UK catering critical control points: Delivery (<5°C/<-18°C), Chilled Storage (<8°C), Cookline (75°C core), Hot Holding (>63°C), and Two-Stage Cooling (60°C to <8°C in 6 hrs).
Full flexibility: add, edit, or remove custom kitchen process steps, assign CCP numbers, and define measurable critical limits.
Dual Export: One-click print to high-contrast A4 landscape table + CSV data export for digital compliance binders.
Strict legal compliance with Article 5 of Regulation (EC) No 852/2004 and Section 21 of the Food Safety Act 1990.
